title: Description and options for Hunyango and Haenau wallpaper types are missing
line: Hunyango and Haenau wallpapers now say what they do in their settings and offer options: a fixed background color for Hunyango and a change interval for Haenau.
explanation: Hunyango and Haenau shipped without a config.qml or main.xml, so picking either in Desktop and Wallpaper left the page empty below the type combo, with no description and no options. The patch adds a config page to each: a one-line description, a Background color choice for Hunyango (change over time, the old behaviour, or a fixed color, which also hides the Randomize Wallpaper Color menu entry), and a Change a layer every spin box for Haenau (default 30 seconds, as before). It also adds Messages.sh files so these strings, and Hunyango's existing menu string, get translated.

commits.message:
wallpapers/hunyango, haenau: add a description and settings

Both wallpapers had no config page, so choosing them left the settings
empty with no hint of what they do. Each now explains itself in a line,
Hunyango can keep one background color and Haenau has a change interval.

BUG: 352346

+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

+<kcfg xmlns="http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0"

diff --git a/wallpapers/haenau/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/haenau/contents/ui/config.qml
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..8f91c1611
--- /dev/null
+++ b/wallpapers/haenau/contents/ui/config.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+/*
+ *   SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+ *
+ *   SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+
+Kirigami.FormLayout {
+    id: root
+    twinFormLayouts: parentLayout
+
+    property alias cfg_ChangeInterval: intervalSpinBox.value
+
+    QQC2.Label {
+        Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 20
+        text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.haenau", "Blue shapes that slowly fade and rearrange themselves.")
+        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
+    }
+
+    QQC2.SpinBox {
+        id: intervalSpinBox
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.haenau", "Change a layer every:")
+        from: 1
+        to: 3600
+        editable: true
+        textFromValue: (value, locale) => i18ndp("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.haenau", "%1 second", "%1 seconds", value)
+        valueFromText: (text, locale) => parseInt(text)
+    }
+}

+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<!--
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+-->
+<kcfg xmlns="http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0"
+      xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+      xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0
+      http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0/kcfg.xsd" >

diff --git a/wallpapers/hunyango/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/hunyango/contents/ui/config.qml
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..f93784266
--- /dev/null
+++ b/wallpapers/hunyango/contents/ui/config.qml

+/*
+ *   SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+ *
+ *   SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
+import org.kde.kquickcontrols as KQuickControls
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+
+Kirigami.FormLayout {
+    id: root
+    twinFormLayouts: parentLayout
+
+    property alias cfg_FixedColor: fixedColorButton.checked
+    property alias cfg_Color: colorButton.color
+
+    QQC2.Label {
+        Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 20
+        text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.hunyango", "Soft circles of light over a colored background.")
+        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
+    }
+
+    QQC2.ButtonGroup {
+        id: colorGroup
+    }
+
+    QQC2.RadioButton {
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.hunyango", "Background color:")
+        text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.hunyango", "Change over time")
+        checked: !fixedColorButton.checked
+        QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: colorGroup
+    }
+
+    RowLayout {
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            id: fixedColorButton
+            text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.hunyango", "Fixed:")
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: colorGroup
+        }
+
+        KQuickControls.ColorButton {
+            id: colorButton
+            enabled: fixedColorButton.checked
+            dialogTitle: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.hunyango", "Select Background Color")
+        }
+    }
+}
